_about: v16.4: Inside C only, a perpendicular circle drawn as the arc on one side of its curve (notes/orthogonal-circle/segments/SPEC.md 9; src/construct.js). id -> {en, ru, note, ctx?}. Built in work/xvhs. Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (V164_SEG_HERE, after the v16.3 table). Terms: «гиперболическая прямая» (the whole geodesic inside C, ends on C), never «отрезок» (a segment has both ends inside C). Review fixes (2026-10-26): 7 entries added (chip.seg_tip_whole, menu.seg_out, row.seg_*_on, row.on_circle, row.on_line); captions close their phrase with a comma in code (app.js pcTidy), no string change.

side.whole.note: Segmented control (chip, Inspector): the whole circle.

side.in.note: Segmented control: the arc inside a circle C.

side.out.note: Inspector control: the arc outside a circle C.

side.left.note: Inspector control, a line C steeper than 45 degrees.

side.right.note: Inspector control, a line C steeper than 45 degrees.

chip.seg_group.note: aria-label of the chip's and the Inspector's control.

chip.seg_tip.en: Inside: only the arc inside the curve (for a line, on the first point's side)
chip.seg_tip.ru: Внутри: только дуга внутри кривой (для прямой — со стороны первой точки)
chip.seg_tip.note: Tooltip of the chip's Inside button.

menu.seg_in.note: Row ⋯ item, a circle C [C26: the name after a colon].

menu.seg_side.ru: Только по одну сторону от кривой: {c}

menu.seg_other.note: Row ⋯ item while Inside C only is on.

menu.seg_whole.note: Row ⋯ item: turns Inside C only off.

row.seg_in.ru: гиперболическая прямая внутри кривой: {c}; через {a} и {b}
row.seg_in.note: Row (short form, the curve first). {a}, {b}: ctx acc.

row.seg_out.ru: гиперболическая прямая вне кривой: {c}; через {a} и {b}
row.seg_out.note: Row, the outside of a circle C.

row.seg_side.en: hyperbolic line on one side of {c}, through {a} and {b}
row.seg_side.ru: гиперболическая прямая по одну сторону от кривой: {c}; через {a} и {b}

insp.seg_t.note: Inspector: what t means on the arc (no-break space before the dash).

cap.seg.en: the hyperbolic line through {a} and {b} in the domain {r}
cap.seg.ru: гиперболическая прямая в области {r}, проходящая через {a} и {b}

cap.seg_on.en: the hyperbolic line in the domain {r} on {k}
cap.seg_on.ru: гиперболическая прямая в области {r}, лежащая на {k}
cap.seg_on.note: Caption when P or Q is off the arc. {k}: K's whole caption in the genitive (= prepositional for «окружности, проходящей…», «прямой, проходящей…»).

cap.seg.gen.en: the hyperbolic line through {a} and {b} in the domain {r}
cap.seg.gen.ru: гиперболической прямой в области {r}, проходящей через {a} и {b}

cap.seg_on.gen.en: the hyperbolic line in the domain {r} on {k}
cap.seg_on.gen.ru: гиперболической прямой в области {r}, лежащей на {k}

chip.seg_tip_whole.note: Tooltip of the chip's Whole button (review user-4).

menu.seg_out.note: Row ⋯ item, a circle C drawn as its complement: the switch turns on its region, outside (review math-6) [C26].

row.seg_in_on.note: Row when P or Q is not strictly inside (review user-6). {k}: row.on_circle or row.on_line.

row.seg_out_on.note: Row, the outside of a circle C, P or Q off it.

row.seg_side_on.en: hyperbolic line on one side of {c}, {k}
row.seg_side_on.ru: гиперболическая прямая по одну сторону от кривой: {c}; {k}
row.seg_side_on.note: Row, a line C, P or Q off the drawn side.

row.on_circle.note: Row tail {k}: K is a circle; the line passes through neither point.

row.on_line.note: Row tail {k}: K is a line.
